investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell script executed on WKSTN-FIN-04 under user j_smith, initiating a hidden command sequence. The script opens a TCP connection to 45.33.19.121 on port 443 and uses remote command execution via iex, indicating potential reverse shell or C2 activity. The initiating process is winword.exe with Outlook as the parent process, suggesting Office-based delivery. Given the external C2 connection, obfuscated invocation, and Office process chaining, this activity is considered High Priority and warrants immediate investigation.
